paragraphs.en: We have all encountered them, in both our personal and professional lives. Think about the times you felt tricked or frustrated by a membership or subscription that had a seamless sign-up process but was later difficult to cancel. Something that should be simple and transparent can be complicated, intentionally or unintentionally, in ways that impair consumer choice. These are examples of dark patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在个人生活和职业生涯中都遇到过它们。想想那些让你感到被欺骗或沮丧的会员资格或订阅服务，它们注册过程无缝顺畅，但后来却很难取消。本应简单透明的事情却可能被有意或无意地复杂化，从而损害消费者的选择权。这些就是暗黑模式的例子。

sentences.en: We have all encountered them, in both our personal and professional lives.
Think about the times you felt tricked or frustrated by a membership or subscription that had a seamless sign-up process but was later difficult to cancel.
Something that should be simple and transparent can be complicated, intentionally or unintentionally, in ways that impair consumer choice.
These are examples of dark patterns.

paragraphs.en: First coined in 2010 by user experience expert Harry Brignull, "dark patterns" is a catch-all term for practices that manipulate user interfaces to influence the decision-making ability of users. Brignull identifies 12 types of common dark patterns, ranging from misdirection and hidden costs to "roach motel", where a user experience seems easy and intuitive at the start, but turns difficult when the user tries to get out.
paragraphs.zh: 2010年由用户体验专家HarryBrignull首次提出，"暗黑模式"是一个概括性术语，指操纵用户界面以影响用户决策能力的做法。Brignull识别出12种常见的暗黑模式类型，从误导和隐藏成本到"蟑螂旅馆"，即用户体验在开始时看起来简单直观，但当用户试图退出时却变得困难。

sentences.en: First coined in 2010 by user experience expert Harry Brignull, "dark patterns" is a catch-all term for practices that manipulate user interfaces to influence the decision-making ability of users.

Brignull identifies 12 types of common dark patterns, ranging from misdirection and hidden costs to "roach motel", where a user experience seems easy and intuitive at the start, but turns difficult when the user tries to get out.

paragraphs.en: In a 2019 study of 53,000 product pages and 11,000 websites, researchers found that about one in 10 employs these design practices. Though widely prevalent, the concept of dark patterns is still not well understood. Business and nonprofit leaders should be aware of dark patterns and try to avoid the gray areas they engender.
paragraphs.zh: 在2019年一项对53000个产品页面和11000个网站的研究中，研究人员发现约十分之一采用了这些设计做法。尽管广泛流行，暗黑模式的概念仍未被充分理解。企业和非营利组织领导者应该意识到暗黑模式，并努力避免它们所产生的灰色地带。

sentences.en: In a 2019 study of 53,000 product pages and 11,000 websites, researchers found that about one in 10 employs these design practices.
Though widely prevalent, the concept of dark patterns is still not well understood.
Business and nonprofit leaders should be aware of dark patterns and try to avoid the gray areas they engender.

paragraphs.en: Where is the line between ethical, persuasive design and dark patterns? Businesses should engage in conversations with IT, compliance, risk, and legal teams to review their privacy policy, and include in the discussion the customer/user experience designers and coders responsible for the company's user interface, as well as the marketers and advertisers responsible for sign-ups, checkout baskets, pricing, and promotions. Any or all these teams can play a role in creating or avoiding "digital deception."
paragraphs.zh: 道德的、具有说服力的设计与暗黑模式之间的界限在哪里？企业应该与IT、合规、风险和法律团队展开对话，审查其隐私政策，并将负责公司用户界面的客户/用户体验设计师和编码人员，以及负责注册、结账篮、定价和促销的营销人员和广告商纳入讨论。这些团队中的任何一个或全部都可能在创造或避免"数字欺骗"中发挥作用。

sentences.en: Where is the line between ethical, persuasive design and dark patterns?

Businesses should engage in conversations with IT, compliance, risk, and legal teams to review their privacy policy, and include in the discussion the customer/user experience designers and coders responsible for the company's user interface, as well as the marketers and advertisers responsible for sign-ups, checkout baskets, pricing, and promotions.
Any or all these teams can play a role in creating or avoiding "digital deception."

paragraphs.en: Lawmakers and regulators are slowly starting to address the ambiguity around dark patterns, most recently at the state level. In March, the California Attorney General announced the approval of additional regulations under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) that "ensure that consumers will not be confused or misled when seeking to exercise their data privacy rights. The regulations aim to ban dark patterns—this means prohibiting companies from using confusing language or unnecessary steps such as forcing them to click through multiple screens or listen to reasons why they shouldn't opt out."
paragraphs.zh: 立法者和监管机构正在缓慢开始解决暗黑模式周围的模糊性问题，最近主要在州一级。3月，加州总检察长宣布批准CaliforniaConsumerPrivacyAct(CCPA)下的附加法规，"确保消费者在寻求行使其数据隐私权时不会感到困惑或被误导。这些法规旨在禁止暗黑模式——这意味着禁止公司使用令人困惑的语言或不必要的步骤，例如强迫他们点击多个屏幕或听取他们不应该选择退出的理由。"

sentences.en: Lawmakers and regulators are slowly starting to address the ambiguity around dark patterns, most recently at the state level.

In March, the California Attorney General announced the approval of additional regulations under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) that "ensure that consumers will not be confused or misled when seeking to exercise their data privacy rights.

The regulations aim to ban dark patterns—this means prohibiting companies from using confusing language or unnecessary steps such as forcing them to click through multiple screens or listen to reasons why they shouldn't opt out."

paragraphs.en: As more states consider promulgating additional regulations, there is a need for greater accountability from within the business community. Dark patterns also can be addressed on a self- regulatory basis, but only if organizations hold themselves accountable, not just to legal requirements but also to industry best practices and standards.
paragraphs.zh: 随着更多州考虑颁布额外的法规，商业界需要更大的问责制。暗黑模式也可以在自律的基础上得到解决，但前提是组织不仅要对法律要求负责，还要对行业最佳实践和标准负责。

sentences.en: As more states consider promulgating additional regulations, there is a need for greater accountability from within the business community.

Dark patterns also can be addressed on a self- regulatory basis, but only if organizations hold themselves accountable, not just to legal requirements but also to industry best practices and standards.

insights.note: 非限制性定语从句补充说明特定名词,从句内部包含并列结构和状语从句嵌套,这种层层修饰的句式在四六级和考研阅读中极为常见,掌握后可直接迁移到大量真题长难句。

insights.en: Though widely prevalent, the concept of dark patterns is still not well understood.
insights.note: 让步状语从句搭配被动语态主句是四六级和考研阅读中的高频句式,尤其是"Though/Although"引导的让步从句。从句省略主语和系动词的用法也很常见。这种转折对比结构在学术写作和议论文中频繁出现,掌握后可应用于大量类似句子

insights.en: Business and nonprofit leaders should be aware of dark patterns and try to avoid the gray areas they engender.
insights.note: 情态动词加并列谓语"should...and(should)..."以及紧贴名词的限制性定语从句都是四六级和考研阅读中的高频句式,这类结构在学术和正式文体中反复出现,掌握后可直接迁移至大量类似句子的理解,典型性较强。

insights.en: Businesses should engage in conversations with IT, compliance, risk, and legal teams to review their privacy policy, and include in the discussion the customer/user experience designers and coders responsible for the company's user interface, as well as the marketers and advertisers responsible for sign-ups, checkout baskets, pricing, and promotions.
insights.note: 本句在主干识别、成分划分和结构典型性方面表现出较高的训练价值，虽然嵌套层次不深、时态语态相对简单，但句子长度适中、成分丰富、结构典型，非常适合作为'句子结构+时态'的综合训练材料，能帮助目标读者在实战中提升分析复杂并列和修饰结构的能力。综合前五维评估，本句值得优先纳入训练库。

insights.en: Any or all these teams can play a role in creating or avoiding "digital deception."
insights.note: 情态动词can加动词原形的结构、后置定语修饰宾语的模式，都是四六级和考研真题中频繁出现的常见句式，具有一定的代表性和迁移价值，但因句子整体过于简单，无复杂嵌套或特殊结构，典型性略打折扣。

insights.en: In March, the California Attorney General announced the approval of additional regulations under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) that "ensure that consumers will not be confused or misled when seeking to exercise their data privacy rights. The regulations aim to ban dark patterns—this means prohibiting companies from using confusing language or unnecessary steps such as forcing them to click through multiple screens or listen to reasons why they shouldn't opt out."
insights.note: 典型的政经/法律类报道句式，大量使用复杂名词短语、嵌套从句和举例结构，在考研和六级长难句中非常普遍。

insights.en: Dark patterns also can be addressed on a self-regulatory basis, but only if organizations hold themselves accountable, not just to legal requirements but also to industry best practices and standards.
insights.note: 本句结构在四六级和考研阅读中较为常见：主句包含情态动词和被动语态，从句使用条件状语引导，且从句内部包含并列状语。这种"主句陈述+条件限定"的句式是学术和议论文写作的典型模式，掌握后可广泛迁移到类似语境。
